questions.question: The minimum value of 2 sin 2 q + 3 cos 2 q is 2 sin 2 q + 3 cos 2 q का न्यूनतम मान है -
questions.questionHtml:
The minimum value of 2 sin2 q + 3 cos2 q is

2 sin2 q + 3 cos2 q का न्यूनतम मान है -
questions.solution:
2 sin2 q + 3 cos2 q

= 2(sin2 q + cos2 q) + cos2 q

= 2 + cos2 q

Since the minimum value of cos2 q is 0, the minimum value of the given expression is 2.

questions.question: If cos 2 θ + 12.5 sin θ - 7 = 0, then the value of sin θ is: यदि cos 2 θ + 12.5 sin θ - 7 = 0 है, तो sin θ का मान है:____
questions.solution:
cos2 θ + 12.5 sin θ - 7 = 0

1 - sin2θ + 12.5 sin θ - 7 = 0

Multiplying by 2 on both sides,

=> 2-2sin2 θ+ 25sin θ-14 = 0

=> 2 sin2 θ -25 sin θ +12 = 0

=> (2sin θ - 1) (sin θ - 12) = 0

=> 2sin θ = 1 (Since sin θ cant be 12, as its maximum value is 1)

=> sin θ = ½

questions.question: What is the value of (cosA + cosB) 2 + (sinA - sinB) 2 ? (cosA + cosB) 2 + (sinA - sinB) 2 ? का मान कितना है ?
questions.questionHtml:
What is the value of (cosA + cosB)2 + (sinA - sinB)2?

(cosA + cosB)2 + (sinA - sinB)2? का मान कितना है ?
questions.solution:
= (cosA + cosB)2 + (sinA - sinB)2

= (cos2A + cos2B + 2cosA.cosB) + (sin2A + sin2B - 2sinA.sinB)

= (cos2A + sin2A) + (cos2B + sin2B) + 2(cosA.cosB - sinA.sinB)

= 1 + 1 + 2cos(A + B)

= 2[1 + cos(A + B)]

= 2[1 + 2cos2(A + B)/2 - 1]

= 2 * 2cos2(A + B)/2

= 4cos2(A + B)/2

p = (1 - Tan2B) and q = (1 - Cot2B)

p = (Cos2B - Sin2B)/Cos2B

q = - (Cos2B - Sin2B)/ Sin2B

p/q = [(Cos2B - Sin2B)/Cos2B]/[ - (Cos2B - Sin2B)/ Sin2B]

p/q = - Sin2B/ Cos2B = - Tan2B

1 - (p/q) = 1 + Tan2B = Sec2B

questions.question: If M sinx - 3 = N cosx and N sinx - 4 = - M cos x, then M 2 + N 2 equals to - यदि M sinx - 3 = N cosx और N sinx - 4 = - M cos x है, तो M 2 + N 2 किसके बराबर है -
questions.solution:
Here, M sinx - 3 = N cosx

M sinx - N cosx = 3 ..(i)

And, N sinx - 4 = - M cos x

N sinx + M cosx = 4 ..(ii)

Taking sinx (i) + cosx (ii), we get

M sin2x - N sinx cosx + M cos2x + N sinx cosx = 3 sinx + 4 cosx

M = 3 sinx + 4 cosx

And, (3 sinx + 4 cosx) sinx - N cosx = 3 = 3(cos2x + sin2x)

N = - 3 cosx + 4 sinx

Therefore,M2 + N2 = (3 sinx + 4 cosx)2 + ( - 3 cosx + 4 sinx)2

= 9 sin2x + 16 cos2x + 24 sinx cosx + 16 sin2x + 9 cos2x - 24 sinx cosx

= 9 + 16

= 25

options.html: Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
Both I and III और II दोनों

questions.solution:
Here, ((9/2)sin2A/cosA) - 6cos2A = 9

(9 sinA cosA/cosA) - 6 + 6sin2A = 9

9sinA + 6sin2A - 15 = 0

2sin2A + 3sinA - 5 = 0

2sin2A + 5sinA - 2sinA - 5 = 0

(sinA - 1)(2sinA + 5) = 0

Then, sin A = 1, A = 90˚

Now, cos2A - cosec A + 2 = cos(2 * 90˚) - cosec 90˚ + 2 = -1 - 1 + 2 = 0

So, I is true.

And, tan(A/2) = tan(90˚/2) = tan 45˚ = 1 ≠ √3

So, II is false.

The expression equal to
tan 53° + cot 33°_________tan 33° + cot 53°
is equal to 

व्यंजक
tan 53° + cot 33°_________tan 33° + cot 53°
का मान किसके बराबर है?
questions.solution:
=(tan53°+cot33°)/(tan33°+cot53°)

= (tan53°+(1/tan33))/(tan33°+(1/tan53))

= (tan53°tan33°+1)/tan33° X tan53°/(1+tan53°tan33°)

= (tan53°)/tan33°

= tan53° cot33°

= cot37° tan57°
